content:
Hello! I am interested in modeling programming languages that involve some nondeterminism, but I'd also ideally like to make this semantics executable (for example to enable differential testing). Interaction trees (a coinductive structure) seem like one way to enable both of these simultaneously.

I realize Lean's native type theory does not support coinduction, however I came across both of these: docs, and this Lean ITree impl (which relies on a dependency that declares itself not at all ready for serious use).

Relying heavily on this given the lack of native support seems questionable at first glance, but perhaps others here have successful workarounds or other solutions to this top-level problem.

Has anyone attempted to work with interaction trees or other coinductive types successfully in lean?

I know of https://github.com/ISTA-PLV/coinductive/, which develops a framework to define coinductive datatypes generally, and which is applied in https://github.com/ISTA-PLV/iris-lean/tree/wpi/IrisITree to define a program logic for iTrees
